QuestInfo.name: A Bright and Sunny Day
QuestInfo.0: It is such a sunny day! Find some way to cool down!
QuestInfo.1: #b#o9420527#s#k are blocking #b#p9270061##k's way to Kampung, and they're carrying coconuts that can help the villagers cool off in this heat.
QuestInfo.2: The coconuts helped the villagers beat the heat.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: 100,000 mesos\nAble to proceed to the 'Too Hot!' quest.\n

0.0: Whew, I'm melting out here! I sure could use something to cool me down!
0.1: You there! Help me! I want whip up a delicious coconut-based beverage to combat this weather, but I'm out of coconuts. It's all those #b#o9420527#s#k running amuck outside the village. I can't get to Kampung to collect my usual supply of coconuts!
0.2: Will you help me get rid of 50 of them and collect #b50 #t4000465#s#k?

yes.0: I hope you return before I pass out from this deadly heat...

no.0: C'mon now, wouldn't you enjoy a nice tall glass of coconut juice?

1.0: You got #b50 #t4000465#s#k! Thank goodness, I'm dying from thirst here!

yes.0: Ah, now we can refresh ourselves with a nice, frothy glass of coconut juice!

item.0: You haven't stomped out #b50 #o9420527#s#k and collected #b50 #t4000465#s#k yet?! Hurry it up! I'm about to melt!
